Boost your app's onboarding conversion by studying the exact flow behind an 18 million dollar ARR health app. Learn how to stop losing users on the screens before your paywall and turn cold traffic into paying subscribers.

We sit down with Asia Paloni, chief product officer at Welltory, an app doing 18 million in ARR with almost 18 million downloads after 10 years. We walk her internal lessons learned deck and the six ingredients she says every pitch needs, from the human problem to the FOMO close. We break down why the very first button asks for health data before any value screen, and why over 90% of users still sync. You will see how showing someone 192 minutes of their own sedentary stress proves more than any five star review or research study. We analyze why benefit driven screens tested worse than fear at the paywall, and why over 60% of conversions land after day one.
